subject: HealthCo pilot: no-train opt-out, EU export controls, and subprocessor evidence
messages:
From: Elena Sokolov <elena@healthco.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: security@healthco.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot data handling — no-train opt-out + export controls

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we scope the pilot I need to confirm a few privacy/security points before we sign the SOW:

1) No-train: can Redwood commit that customer-provided prompts and model responses will not be used to improve models (no-training) for our tenant? If yes, what is the enforcement mechanism?

2) EU export: the pilot will include EEA patient metadata and clinical notes. Where will inference occur and will any data leave the EU? Is there a written assurance we can include in the DPA?

3) Subprocessors/evidence: we need a current subprocessor list and SOC2/SAA evidence for any infra partner that might touch unredacted data.

Attached is our security questionnaire (partial) — please complete relevant sections and return.

Elena
Head of Data Governance
HealthCo

Attachment: HealthCo_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Elena Sokolov <elena@healthco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot data handling — no-train opt-out + export controls

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. I pulled in Aditya (legal) and Neha (account lead) so we can get you a consolidated plan and evidence pack. High-level answers and next steps below: 

Summary answers (short):
- No-train: yes — we can offer a tenant-level no-train commitment for API traffic used in the pilot. This is implemented via a data-tagging and retention policy plus a contractual addendum.
- EU export: for the pilot we can pin processing to our Frankfurt region; no data will be exported outside EU for that tenant unless explicitly enabled by you.
- Subprocessors: we maintain an up-to-date CSV and can provide SOC2 attestations for infra partners.

Proposed immediate steps (timeline):
1) Legal addendum: Aditya to share a short amendment with explicit no-train language for prompts/responses and limited telemetry carve-outs (48–72h).
2) Evidence pack: share subprocessor CSV, SOC2 link, and a signed attestation (within 3 business days).
3) Tenant enablement: infra to pin tenant to eu-central1 and enable no-train flag; implementation checklist to you for validation (ETA 5 business days after signed addendum).
4) DocuSign: one-click addendum for PO sign-off.

Open questions for you:
- Do you need prompt/response export controls (ability to download transcripts) disabled for users during the pilot?
- Any strict retention windows we should enforce?

I attached a one-page implementation checklist to make the rollout easier. If that looks good I will schedule a follow-up call with infra and legal tomorrow.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: implementation-checklist.csv (CSV)

From: Elena Sokolov <elena@healthco.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot data handling — no-train opt-out + export controls

Thanks Grace — that flow works for us. A couple of clarifications: 

- We do not want transcripts/export enabled for clinicians during the pilot (download/export disabled).
- Retention: we request a default 30-day retention for unredacted prompts/responses unless we explicitly approve longer.
- Ownership: confirm that prompts/responses remain HealthCo IP and Redwood will not claim derivative rights.

I've attached our POC scope doc so you can see the data types.

Elena

Attachment: POC_scope.pdf (PDF)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Sokolov <elena@healthco.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot data handling — no-train opt-out + export controls

Elena — looping in legal response and proposed amendment language. Key points below (summary first):

1) No-train commitment scope: we can accept a no-training obligation limited to customer-provided content (prompts, files, responses) submitted via the API/UI for the duration of the pilot and while the feature flag is enabled. This will be contractual and enforced operationally by excluding tagged tenant traffic from model-improvement pipelines.

2) Telemetry carve-outs: We reserve the right to collect system telemetry/metrics (latency, error rates, aggregated usage counts) for service operation and capacity planning. Any telemetry used for model improvement will be anonymized and aggregated; we will exclude tenant-tagged content from training datasets.

3) Ownership: we will confirm in the amendment that HealthCo retains ownership of prompts and responses. Redwood retains rights to service-level aggregated outputs (e.g., anonymized usage patterns) but no derivative IP from your content.

4) EU processing/export: we will pin processing to EU region and include a DPA clause preventing transfers without prior written consent. We will outline subprocessors and provide SOC2 evidence for those with potential access.

Proposed contract snippet (draft):
"Redwood will not use Customer Content (defined as prompts, files, and generated responses tied to the Customer tenant) to train, improve, or otherwise materially update models used for inference, unless Customer provides an explicit opt-in. Redwood will maintain operational controls to exclude tenant-tagged content from model training pipelines and will provide evidence of exclusion on request."

I'll attach a draft amendment for review. If HealthCo is comfortable with the snippet above we can finalize and route via DocuSign.

— Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: no-train-amendment-draft.docx (document)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Elena Sokolov <elena@healthco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot data handling — no-train opt-out + export controls

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and helpful details. Below is a consolidated implementation plan and the actions we will take once we have a signed amendment.

Implementation plan (post-signature):
1) Legal: finalize and sign no-train amendment via DocuSign (we will route the no-train snippet plus retention/export controls). Link sent after final sign-off.
2) Tenant configuration: infra will pin HealthCo tenant to eu-central (Frankfurt) and enable tenant-no-train flag. This sets processing region and excludes content from training. (ETA 48–72 hours after signature.)
3) Retention/exports: set default retention to 30 days for unredacted prompts/responses; export/download functionality disabled for clinician roles by default during the pilot.
4) Evidence & subprocessors: we will provide the live subprocessor CSV and SOC2 links; for any subprocessor with access we will provide specific attestation.
5) Validation call: schedule a 30–45m call with your security team to walk the infra changes and provide access to the evidence pack.

Open items for HealthCo to confirm so we can proceed:
- Signatory for the amendment (name + email).
- Whether you require an independent attestation (e.g., third-party scan) prior to the pilot start.

I'll send the DocuSign link for the amendment once Aditya posts the final language (we expect that today). Thanks — we aim to have the pilot gated and live within one week of signature.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
